@graph.name: Hallucinogen Misuse Treatment (LSD, Psilocybin, PCP, Ketamine) — Launch To Wellness
@graph.description: Treatment for hallucinogen misuse — LSD, psilocybin, PCP, ketamine & DMT. Learn the risks, HPPD, and how hallucinogens differ from therapeutic psychedelics.

acceptedAnswer.text: Classic psychedelics like LSD rarely cause physical dependence, but ketamine and PCP can drive compulsive use — and any hallucinogen can become psychologically entangled with escape and avoidance.
Hallucinogen Persisting Perception Disorder — ongoing visual disturbances (halos, trails, static) and flashbacks that persist after use stops. It’s treatable with professional support.

mainEntity.name: Aren’t psychedelics used in therapy now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clinical research uses screened patients, controlled doses, and trained clinicians in monitored settings. Recreational use has none of those safeguards and carries real risks.

mainEntity.name: Can one bad trip cause lasting problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: For some people, yes — particularly anxiety, panic symptoms, or perceptual changes. These respond well to treatment.

mainEntity.name: When does hallucinogen use need treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: When use is escalating, interfering with daily life, worsening mental health, or you’ve tried to stop and couldn’t. A confidential assessment is the easiest way to find out.
